summary: Grant Applied ML limited publish permissions for Quantization Profile Library (model registry)
description:
Request: Grant a limited set of Applied ML engineers permission to publish/update Redwood-published quantization profiles in the model registry.

Background:
Applied ML is standing up the opt-in Quantization Profile Library and needs to publish signed, versioned artifacts (manifest + calibration notes + constraints) into the registry for evaluation/beta. Today only Platform Eng has publish access, which is blocking the evaluation/publish workflow.

Access needed (least privilege):
- Ability to create/update quantization profile artifacts ONLY (artifact kind: quant_profile), scoped to approved namespaces (e.g., /quant-profiles/redwood-published/*).
- No permission to publish base model weights, change model routing defaults, or modify customer/org config.
- All publish actions must emit audit log entries (who/what/when), and require signed artifacts with server-side verification.

Requested users (Applied ML):
- Arjun Desai (Quantization profiles lead)
- Priyanka Bose (Quantization pipeline)
- Jonas Weber (Evals/perf lead)

Business justification:
- Unblocks profile iteration, evaluation, and the beta timeline; reduces dependency on Platform Eng for routine updates.

Security considerations:
- Profiles are executable-adjacent configuration that can impact runtime behavior; publishing must be restricted and auditable.
- Require security sign-off for the initial access grant and confirmation that artifact signing/verification is enforced.

References:
- Confluence: threat model for profile distribution/signing/auditability ("Threat Model: Quantization Profile Distribution")
- GitHub: model registry publish API permission checks (redwood-model-registry PR #931)

Acceptance criteria:
1) Requested users added to an access group with restricted quant_profile publish permissions.
2) Verified: publishing a profile creates an audit log entry with actor + profile_id + version.
3) Verified: publish endpoint rejects unsigned/invalid signature artifacts.
4) Confirmation posted in this ticket with what was granted and how to request additions/removals.
